title: CodeCataloguePackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly code-catalogue (INV-REQ-2429, INV-REQ-418, INV-REQ-774): the GST category code catalogue, one entry per code of the five R1 Annex E groups, carrying the Annex E group, the side, the Annex E rate, the submission rate where R1 gives one, the source class and the citation, and the completeness flag. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by rules-svc at the pack dry run and by the seed content test, not here: code is unique across codes; a code outside the pack is never submitted (RUL-006) and a mapping entry naming one is refused at sign-off (RUL-009); the catalogue defines codes, not scope; the prevailing rate of a code is the annexERate of its entry in the pack version that resolves at the transaction date (INV-REQ-684, INV-REQ-770), NA meaning the submissionRate applies, and a rate change is a new pack version; that every entry of the Annex E catalogue is PRIMARY and complete is true is seed content. No entry is written here; the 35 entries are seed content read from R1 Annex E printed pages 79 to 83. A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

complete.description: The completeness flag of the catalogue (INV-REQ-418): true when the catalogue is built from R1 Annex E in full.

codes.description: The catalogue entries, one per code.

code.description: The IRAS category code as R1 Annex E prints it.

group.description: The Annex E group of the code.

side.description: The side of the code: SUPPLY for the supply groups, PURCHASE for the purchase groups.

annexERate.description: The rate Annex E prints for the code, a decimal string, or the literal NA where Annex E gives none. The prevailing rate of the code in the pack version that resolves at the transaction date (INV-REQ-684, INV-REQ-770); NA means the submissionRate applies; a rate change is a new pack version.

submissionRate.description: The submission rate where R1 gives one (for example 0 for NA and TXNA, R1 section 11.19), a decimal string.

sourceClass.description: The source class of the entry.

sourceReference.description: The citation of the entry, the Annex E page.
